name: An up counter: count presses to 3, then Reset

tags.name: Ticket
tags.comment: a push button: each press is one count (CU)

tags.name: Reset
tags.comment: a push button: the counter's reset (R)

tags.name: Three
tags.comment: a lamp: on while the count is 3 or more (Q)

rungs.comment: Each time Ticket turns on, C1.CV goes up by 1. Holding it down is still one count. Reset sets CV back to 0.
Three lights while C1.CV is at least 3, and stays lit at 4, 5, 6 and on.
